fields.statement: At 5218260b built rhiza into $TMPDIR and drove it in a scratch repo (one accepted milestone change set with a leaf, Rex faked to log only, RHIZA_* run vars unset). RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES=1 GiB without RHIZA_TEST_NOW is now ignored: with the real statfs (55 GiB free, default 10 GiB minimum) daemon --once started the run and logged rex window new. With RHIZA_TEST_NOW also set, the same 1 GiB is honoured: nothing started, daemon status shows 'Skipped: <cs> Built: disk space is low (1.0 GiB free, under the minimum of 10.0 GiB)'. --min-free 100G against the real statfs skips with '54.3 GiB free, under the minimum of 100.0 GiB'; --min-free 1G starts the run. go test of daemon-picks, daemon-notify-disk-low, inbox-disk-low and describe-golden: ok.

At 5218260b, same scratch repo and built binary, real statfs with --min-free 100G then 1G, each daemon --once: poll 1 (low) emits the OSC 7501 state=blocked notice 'disk space is low: the daemon holds new starts and resumes' on the very first --once poll, and rhiza inbox --json lists one item of kind disk-low; poll 2 (still low) sends no notice; poll 3 (enough space) starts the run, sends no disk-low notice and the inbox has no disk-low item; poll 4 (low again) sends a fresh notice. The cycle-1 one-poll-late notice is fixed.
